description: This PHP source file defines the 'HolidayAPI' class within the 'OrangeHRM\Leave\Api' namespace. The class implements REST API endpoints for managing holiday records in the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system, including methods for retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting holiday data. It uses traits and other classes for validation, data modeling, and interaction with holiday data access objects.

classes.name: HolidayAPI
classes.description: The 'HolidayAPI' class provides REST API endpoints for managing holiday records, including retrieving single or multiple holidays, creating new holidays, updating existing ones, and deleting holidays. It extends 'Endpoint' and implements 'CrudEndpoint', utilizing traits for service access and validation rules, and defines methods corresponding to HTTP verbs (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE) with appropriate OpenAPI annotations.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific holiday record by its ID using the holiday service DAO, throws exception if not found, and returns the holiday data modeled as 'HolidayModel'.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Fetches a list of holidays filtered by 'fromDate' and 'toDate', supports sorting and pagination, and returns a collection of holiday models along with total count.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new Holiday entity from request parameters and saves it through the holiday service, returning the created holiday data.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing holiday record identified by ID, with parameters from the request, and saves the updated record.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes multiple holidays identified by an array of IDs from the request; returns the list of deleted IDs.

methods.name: getIdFromUrlAttributes
methods.description: Extracts the holiday ID from URL attributes in the request.

methods.name: getIdParamRule
methods.description: Defines validation rule for the holiday ID parameter, requiring it to be a positive integer.

methods.name: setHolidayParams
methods.description: Sets holiday properties (name, date, recurring, length) on a Holiday object from the request body parameters.

methods.name: getCommonBodyParamRuleCollection
methods.description: Defines common validation rules for the request body when creating or updating a holiday, including name length, date format, boolean/recur status, and length value.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the 'getOne' method, validating that the ID parameter is provided and valid.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the 'getAll' method, validating filter parameters and pagination/sorting parameters.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for creating a holiday, ensuring required fields are present and valid.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for updating a holiday, including ID validation and body field validation.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Returns validation rules for deleting holidays, ensuring IDs array is provided and valid.
